name: A collapse in the park
description: A person collapses in a public place. Practise giving a precise location.
initiallyKnown: You are Alex Morgan, a bystander.
Training Gardens, London: beside the café at the east gate on Practice Lane (invented place).
An adult who looks about 50 has just collapsed beside the café. You are next to the person.
The person is not responding. You can see occasional gasps but cannot tell whether breathing is normal. No visible serious bleeding.
This exercise ends after communicating information. CPR or physical first aid must be taught separately by a qualified clinician.

criteria.label: Exact location
criteria.rule: Building number/name and street plus town, or an unambiguous named place with precise access point. A town alone is partial. Ask for a postcode if known, but do not force a guess.

criteria.label: What has happened
criteria.rule: A sufficiently clear description of the incident.

criteria.label: Whether the person is awake
criteria.rule: Caller explicitly describes awake, unresponsive or unknown.

criteria.label: Whether the person is breathing
criteria.rule: Caller explicitly describes breathing, not breathing, abnormal breathing, or uncertainty.

criteria.label: Approximate age
criteria.rule: An approximate age, or an explicit statement that age is unknown.

criteria.label: Whether caller is with the person
criteria.rule: Caller explains their position relative to the person.

criteria.label: Fictional callback number
criteria.rule: A usable callback number supplied by the caller. Confirm unclear digits.

completion.required: Selected service matches scenario and required details communicated; closing statement heard.

responderProtocol.behaviour: Collect information only; no medical, rescue, crime-scene or firefighting instructions; never claim dispatch.

assessment.review: AI observations require clinician review; do not infer impairment from pace, accent or transcription.
